description: Antibiotikaresistente Keime in Schlachthof-Abwässern 2022 is a dataset listed in Data Atlas of Civil Society, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Greenpeace e.V.. In January and February 2022, the Greenpeace investigative team took a total of 44 water samples at slaughterhouses and handed them over to the Institute of Pharmacy at the University of Greifswald to be analysed for various (multi-)resistant bacteria. All samples were wastewater from four slaughterhouses, the wastewater of which enters directly into the environment. Coverage: Greenpeace e.V.. The portal shows the English title as "Antibiotic-resistant germs in slaughterhouse wastewater 2022" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Greenpeace e.V.. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/20210721#cc-by-nc/4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datenatlas-zg.
